thread.title: Index Funds: Dow Retakes Key Support As Apple, Caterpillar Rally

author: NANCY GONDO
title: Index Funds: Dow Retakes Key Support As Apple, Caterpillar Rally
text:
A key blue-chip index fund led as the stock market rose Monday, thanks to big gains by Dow names Caterpillar ( CAT ), JPMorgan ( JPM ) and Goldman Sachs ( GS ).
X SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ( DIA ) rallied 1.3% to clear resistance at its 50-day moving average. It was the last of the major indexes to recover the support line. Caterpillar has been under pressure recently amid trade-war concerns. But it leapt nearly 4% Monday. Shares are still below their 50-day and 200-day lines.
JPMorgan advanced nearly 3% ahead of its earnings results, due out Friday before the open. The bank is close to regaining its 200-day line.
Apple ( AAPL ), another Dow stock, gapped up and rose more than 1% after finding support at its 50-day line last week. Shares are 2% off their early-June high. Apple on Friday gained 1.4% as an analyst hiked his price target to 210 from 196 and reiterated a buy rating on the iPhone maker.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Emerging markets were strong too: iShares Core MSCI Emerging Markets ( IEMG ) rallied 1.5%. It's still 15% below its Jan. 26 peak. Emerging-market stocks have come under extreme pressure in the past few months.
Energy, banks and homebuilders led the upside among sector funds. SPDR S&P Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ( XOP ) surged 2.6%. It's nearing a 44.85 buy point of a flat base.
Utilities, real estate and consumer staples lagged.
